name: Seoul
paragraphs: The Seoul file is WMO 47108, height 85 m, position 37°34′17″N, 126°57′56″E. The South Korea sheet uses the same station.

The highest average high in the table is 30 °C, in August. The lowest average low is -5.5 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is July, at 414.4 mm, and the driest is January, at 16.8 mm. The plug, currency, time-zone, and entry lines are national and repeat the South Korea sheet.

climate.caption: Station: Seoul, WMO 47108.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3. Some values are printed without a decimal place, such as 11, and are shown that way.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and F, 220 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows the Republic of Korea at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: The Korea Tourism Organization guide says Korea practices right-hand traffic: stay on the right side of the road, and the driver's seat is on the left.
driving.sourceTitle: VisitKorea, Your Guide to Driving in Korea

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.detail: The Korea Tourism Organization's food guide says: "Tipping is not required or expected in Korea."

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for South Korea, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Won and the code KRW under the country name Korea (the Republic of).

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give South Korea one row, Asia/Seoul. There is no second zone for the country in either file.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.publisher: Ministry of Justice of Korea, K-ETA
entry.note: The official Korea Electronic Travel Authorization site. We do not restate a visa rule.
